description: Capitalization rate of an income property (net operating income / property value), plus gross rent multiplier and price per unit. Give noi_usd directly or gross income and operating expenses. Use cash_on_cash when financing matters. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/cap-rate-calculator

noi_usd.description: Annual net operating income. If omitted, gross income minus operating expenses is used.

operating_expenses_usd.description: Annual operating expenses, excluding mortgage payments.

property_value_usd.description: Purchase price or current market value.

units.description: Number of units, for price per unit. 0 to skip.

name: cap_rate
title: Cap rate calculator
